description: Implement Iceberg merge for deduplication across writes
steps: Enhance `silver/writer.py` with merge/overwrite logic
Define merge key matching entity dedup_key
Implement conflict resolution: latest wins by `updated_at` or `event_ts`
Replace simple append with merge-based writes where appropriate
Capture merge statistics (inserts, updates)

description: Handle late-arriving data writing to historical partitions
steps: Allow writes to old event_ts partitions (Iceberg supports natively)
Add warning log if writing to partition >7 days old
Test: process data for old date after newer dates already processed
Verify late data lands in correct event_ts partition
Document late-arrival tolerance window

description: Deduplicate across multiple Bronze runs for the same date
steps: Handle multiple Bronze manifests for same (platform, entity, dt)
Use Iceberg merge to deduplicate records from different run_ids
Track which run_id contributed each final record (metadata field)
Ensure reprocessing same manifest is idempotent
When a snapshot manifest exists for a (platform, entity, dt), it supersedes all prior delta manifests for that same key — skip deltas that precede the latest snapshot

description: Tests for upsert, late data, and cross-run dedup
steps: Test upsert with new records (insert path)
Test upsert with existing records (update path)
Test conflict resolution produces correct winner
Test late-arriving data writes to correct partition
Test cross-run dedup produces correct final state
